run_eval_model: run evaluation on a pre-trained model using the hf backend with default lm-eval tasks
run_eval_vllm: run evaluation on a model using the vllm backend with custom tensor parallel size
run_eval_task_by_task: run evaluation on tasks sequentially with automatic retry on out of memory errors
run_eval_diffusion: run evaluation on a diffusion model with CLIP metrics and custom guidance scale
parse_vllm_args: parse a comma separated string of vllm arguments into a typed dictionary of kwargs
